evaporation_model: explicit Hertz-Knudsen rate with Clausius-Clapeyron vapor pressure; mass and total-enthalpy bounds; no boiling-temperature reset
Pincident_W_definition: configured laser power while laser is on; zero when off
Eincident_J_definition: configured incident power times actual_dt; per solver step, not per CSV interval or cumulative
diagnostic_Eincident_cumulative_J_defini: incident power integrated over illumination time; cumulative audit only
Eevap_J_definition: carried enthalpy only; excludes separately reported Elatent_vaporization_J
diagnostic_Eevap_total_removed_J_definit: vaporization latent + carried enthalpy; solver energy audit

gas_species_models.argon: thermal background; local thermal equilibrium; no flow
gas_species_models.Ti-6Al-4V_metal_vapor: cumulative evaporation source only; no independent density, temperature, transport or condensation field

physical_model: laser + XYZ conduction + dynamic gas-facing convection/radiation + surface mass-loss evaporation; no melt flow
absorptivity_model: user-specified solid/liquid absorptivity, linear liquid-fraction interpolation
evaporation_surface_model: liquid faces weighted by vertical open fraction; consistent with laser coverage; lateral connectivity not resolved
evaporation_rate_sampling: predicted temperature before evaporation; explicit time integration
recoil_pressure_model: 0.54*P_atm*exp(Lv*M*(T-Tb)/(R*T*Tb)); keyhole-opening voxel proxy, not CFD or a calibrated Ti64 free-surface model
heat_loss_area_model: all current XYZ metal/gas faces, recomputed after each voxel-depletion update; includes internal pores
geometry_axis_convention: array axes=(x,y,z); k=0 is build-plate bottom; laser enters from high z
boundary_surface_model: all XYZ metal-gas interfaces including internal pores; powder contact uses conduction; z=0 uses bottom boundary
